newsitem.title: USA: UST to acquire financial firm.
newsitem.headline: UST to acquire financial firm.

text.p: UST Corp said Tuesday it has a definitive agreement to acquire Firestone Financial Corp in a stock transaction valued at about $27.4 million.

The transaction, which will be accounted for as a pooling of interests, is structured as a tax-free exchange of 0.63 shares of UST common stock for each share of Firestone common stock, up to a maximum value of $30 million, the company said.
UST said it expects the transaction will close during the fourth quarter of 1997.

There are two million outstanding shares of Firestone common stock, which is closely held. At UST's closing price of $21.75 on August 8, the transaction would be valued at approximately $27.4 million, the company said.
UST said it expects the transaction will be immediately accretive, following an estimated one-time pre-tax charge of $900,000 for acquisition-related costs.

Under the agreement, Firestone will initially become a wholly-owned subsidiary of UST and, following requisite regulatory approval, a wholly-owned subsidiary of USTrust. The acquisition will add about $87 million in assets to UST's existing $3.6 billion base, the company said.
The agreement is subject to the approval of federal and state bank regulatory authorities.
UST is bank holding company that serves as the parent company to USTrust and United States Trust Co.
